A QUICK SNAPSHOT

About Franziska

Franziska is a maverick entrepreneur, renowned communication specialist, award-winning international keynote speaker, mad adventurer, bestselling author and the founder of Basic Bananas, Oceanlovers and Moments of Humanity.

Combining strategy, science, innovation and psychology, Franziska’s work has helped thousands of individuals and companies across the globe to improve their communication, spark creativity and tap into courage.

Often rated as the #1 female speaker and referred to as one the smartest women in the entrepreneurial space, Franziska was awarded the NSW Young Entrepreneur of the Year Award in 2013.

Franziska’s down-to-earth approach is like a breath of fresh air. She’s quick at winning over the hearts and minds of her audiences through her boundless energy, realness, deep insights and playful approach.

A Swiss born Australian (or Swaussie) with a sharp-witted humour and an amazing ability to keep her audience members at the edge of their seats, her authentic style leaves everyone engaged, inspired and motivated.

More about Franziska

With a wealth of experiences to draw from, Franziska is known for her generosity and breaking the complex down into practical lessons.

Whether you are looking for a keynote speaker, emcee or panelist, Franziska brings a vibrant, joyful and sassy difference to any event your audiences will connect with and appreciate.

  • International keynote speaker
  • 4 x Best-Selling Author
  • Communication specialist and advisor to some of the world’s leading companies
  • Regional APAC Communication Expert for Entrepreneurs Organization
  • Mentor and investor at the Founder Institute
  • Winner of the Young Entrepreneurs Award
  • Eternal Optimist and Visionary
